svg.title: OpenSwimMeet final heat
svg.desc: A top-down eight-lane pool with lane ropes and backstroke flags. The final heat swims as an arrowhead: the top seed leads in lane 4, with seeds 2 through 8 in lanes 5, 3, 6, 2, 7, 1, and 8. Beside it, a printed psych sheet for a 50 freestyle lists seed times with heat and lane, ending with a no-time entry. Footer: HY3 times parsed, 92 parser tests.
